Lina Gomez: Starting a compact QBR run for Northbridge — target exec brief with VP Ops (Carla) next Fri. Need slide + one-pager + asks by Thu EOD.
Rahul Mehta: Got it. I'll pull usage trends and churn signal. Any strong renewal risk flags we should preface?
Priya Singh: Onboarding status: 78% complete. Two enablement workshops still pending with product team; blocking doc access for end users.
Tom Avery: Integration issues are the main risk right now: batch ingest lag and webhook ordering. I can draft remediation bullets.
Lina Gomez: Good. Plan for dry run Wed 4pm PT (30m). Exec sync will be a separate 15m slot with Carla if she wants to join.
Jordan Park: I can take the remediation slide + owner table. Will include short risk level (P0/P1/P2). ETA Tue noon.
Priya Singh: I'll finish the enablement checklist and attach attendee list by Tue 5pm. Also capture feedback themes from last month: docs clarity, SSO edge cases, demo data.
Rahul Mehta: Sharing provisional renewal signal doc: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/northbridge-qbr (please add comments).
Lina Gomez: Thanks. Two asks from Execs last quarter to call out: 1) cost-opportunity by quantized batch size, 2) fallbacks for critical webhooks.
Tom Avery: Draft remediation table below:
```
Area | Symptom | Owner | Short-term fix | Target
Batch ingest | Lag during peak | Tom Avery | Increase consumer parallelism | 3d
Webhook ordering | Out-of-order events | Jordan Park | Add sequence checks + replay | 7d
SSO token | Expiry edgecases | Priya Singh | Add token refresh guidance | 5d
```
Priya Singh: Small note: training drop-off at step 3 is 28% — adding an async walkthrough video should help.
Lina Gomez: ACTION: Jordan to produce one-pager (1 page) with asks + cost ask by Thu 10am.
Jordan Park: ACTION: Will deliver one-pager and remediation slide by Thu 9am.
Rahul Mehta: ACTION: I'll finalize renewal heatmap and attach slide by Wed 3pm.
Tom Avery: ACTION: I'll prepare a short demo snippet to show failing webhook case for run-through by Wed 4pm.
cs-bot: Reminder: Dry run Wed 16:00 PT. Upload slide deck to the shared folder 30m before.
Lina Gomez: If Carla is available earlier, we can shorten dry run to 20m focusing on asks + risk mitigation. Otherwise keep 30m. Ping here with any new blockers. :rocket:
